summary: Linkage Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing two items: (1) an addendum to a securities purchase agreement extending the registration deadline for 833,333 shares sold at $0.60/share for $500,000 gross proceeds from 30 to 60 business days post-closing, and (2) a newly approved share repurchase program authorizing up to $8,000,000 of Class A ordinary shares. The repurchase program represents a direct capital return to shareholders. Board approval is stated; no advisor named. The filing combines a routine private placement amendment with a significant buyback announcement. The repurchase program signals management's view of undervaluation; watch execution pace and market impact.
